supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The brow ridge extends significantly beyond the outer corners of the eyes, creating a prominent lateral shelf.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle and mental regions exhibit a high-contrast transition to lighter grey/white pixels compared to the dark, high-melanin periocular and cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness with a discernible downward structural droop at the corners of the mouth.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white and grey hair coverage across the chin and lower mandibular region.
